latest.title: Measuring CPR ventilation rate with capnography
latest.finding: Moderate-to-good agreement with independent detectors (ICC 0.72–0.82, limits of agreement ±6.8 breaths/min) but no association between ventilation rate and ROSC (OR 1.09 per 2 breaths/min, 95% CI 0.91–1.30)
